name: Horse
intro: A horse is a big, strong animal. People ride horses and take care of them.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A horse is a big animal with four long legs.
It has long hair on its neck called a mane.
It has a long, swishy tail.
Its feet are hard hooves.
Horses can be brown, black, gray, red, or spotted.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Many horses live with people.
People keep horses on farms and use them for work.
Some horses live in the wild.
Horses live together in groups called herds.
One horse keeps watch while the others rest.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Horses eat only plants.
They eat grass and hay.
They also like apples and carrots.
Horses nibble food all day long.
They drink lots of water every day.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby horse is called a foal.
A mother horse is called a mare.
A mare usually has one foal at a time.
A foal can stand and run soon after it is born.
A foal drinks milk from its mom.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Horses can sleep standing up.
Horses can see almost all the way around.
Horses breathe only through their nose.
Horses can turn their ears to hear sounds.
A pony is a small kind of horse.
